lock_effect: Every stage chip on both boards carries the keyline treatment permanently; chip fills stay flat panel tokens, and colour is never the only signal (the stage label remains printed on the chip).

mutations.change: Add a 3px leading-edge keyline in the chip's status colour; the chip body stays on the flat panel ground with its printed stage label unchanged.
Keyline in --status-conflict-text red; this is the only chip state that may use the conflict colour.
Keyline in --status-offline-text muted; quiet states stay quiet.

summary: Stage chips gain a 3px status keyline on their leading edge, coloured by the package's status tokens, so a chip's state reads at scan distance without relying on the chip's text or fill alone.
